reference_solution:
import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
if not data:
    sys.exit()

n = data[0]
left = [0] * (n + 1)
right = [0] * (n + 1)
pos = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    left[i] = data[pos]
    right[i] = data[pos + 1]
    pos += 2

ans = 0
stack = [(1, 1)]
while stack:
    u, depth = stack.pop()
    if u == 0:
        continue
    ans = max(ans, depth)
    if left[u] != 0:
        stack.append((left[u], depth + 1))
    if right[u] != 0:
        stack.append((right[u], depth + 1))

print(ans)
